text: Corrosion protection: all outdoor structural steel shall be hot-dip galvanised per EN ISO 1461 (mean coating thickness not less than 85 microns for sections over 6 mm, 70 microns for 3 mm to 6 mm) as required by ER-13.03; the corrosivity category is C5 with durability H (DP-CASE-0003, more than 15 years to first major maintenance). Where galvanising is impractical (large welded assemblies, site-welded joints, steel in the splash zone, surfaces of members after erection damage), painting per ISO 12944 C5 high durability (or CX for the splash zone) with a duplex system shall be used per the painting and coating specification ALP-EPC-00000-ME-SPC-0002 and GE-SPC-0004; touch-up of galvanising damage with zinc-rich paint is required.
